messages.content: Design and develop a fitness application capable of monitoring and recording a user's geographical location.

message.content:
# Fitness App with Geolocation Tracking

I'll design a comprehensive fitness application that monitors and records users' geographical location during workouts. This will include both the architecture and a working prototype.

## System Architecture

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    Fitness App                          │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  ┌─────────────┐  ┌─────────────┐  ┌─────────────────┐  │
│  │   User      │  │   Workout   │  │   Analytics     │  │
│  │   Profile   │  │   Engine    │  │   Dashboard     │  │
│  └─────────────┘  └─────────────┘  └─────────────────┘  │
│                  ┌─────────────────┐                    │
│                  │  Geolocation    │                    │
│                  │  Service        │                    │
│                  └─────────────────┘                    │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```
